prompt.project_info: Create a cinematic low-key portrait of an adult fashion model surrounded by dense red roses in a dark minimalist room.
prompt.main_subject: Clearly adult fictional woman with very long sleek black hair, glam makeup, calm introspective downward gaze, fitted red maxi dress with thin straps and secure coverage, minimal necklace, seated with legs folded to the side and arms resting on a bouquet.
prompt.composition_elements: 4:5 slightly overhead centered symmetry, glossy white reflective floor, many red rose bouquets in clear glass vases arranged around the subject, foreground roses softly blurred, deep vignette.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Single soft spotlight from above-left, minimal fill, chiaroscuro, controlled highlights on roses and hair, rich reds with cool dark shadows.
prompt.technical_specs: 50mm lens at f/2.0, subject face and nearest bouquet sharp, subtle fine film grain, realistic anatomy, no text or logos.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Cinematic 4:5 low-key fashion portrait of a clearly adult fictional woman with very long sleek black hair, glam makeup and calm downward gaze, fitted red maxi dress with secure coverage, seated with legs folded to the side among dense red rose bouquets in clear glass vases, glossy white reflective floor, slightly overhead centered composition, soft overhead-left spotlight, deep vignette, 50mm f/2.0, fine film grain, no text.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, transparent dress, sexualized pose, child, teen, ageless person, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, plastic skin, over-smooth, watermark, logo, text, extra fingers, deformed
